home.bannerTitle: More to enjoy, less to pay
home.bannerLead: Discover local deals on cleaning, beauty and chauffeur services.
home.title: Local experiences at a fair price
home.lead: Clear prices including VAT, real local businesses and a {days}-day refund on unused vouchers.
home.emptyTitle: The first deals are on their way
home.emptyText: Local businesses are joining Vendelia right now. Run a business? Be among the first to list your offer.
home.step1Text: Every deal shows the final price including VAT, what's included and the terms.
home.step2Text: Pay by online banking, MobilePay or card. You see every charge before you pay.
home.step3Text: Your voucher and its exact expiry date arrive by email and in My vouchers.
home.step4Text: Book with the business as the deal describes and show your code on site.
home.refundText: Changed your plans? Cancel an unused voucher in My vouchers within {days} days of purchase. Vouchers are valid for {months} calendar months.
home.bizText: We showcase your products and services to people looking for their next local discovery, helping you turn that visibility into bookings and sales.
home.bizPoint1: Help people discover your business when they are looking for something new nearby.
home.bizPoint2: Present your products, services and offers in one place.
home.bizPoint3: Create deals and check and redeem vouchers in your business portal.
home.bizPoint2Title: Showcase what makes you stand out

qrScanner.title: Scan a voucher
qrScanner.instructions: Point your camera at the QR code on the customer’s voucher. Scanning checks the code; you will confirm redemption separately.
